messages.body: All 18 t266 clips (plain/g981/g490 x seeds1-6, 93f k12) generated and fetched. My naive background-subtraction tracker fails: the camera pans/zooms and the ball is dark on a dark table (contact sheets show this). No finding yet. Next: measure with the seeded trackers (raj-3 seeded.py / raj-2 firstfall.py), or label first-bounce frames by hand, then post a finding with the TTM prior-work note. Clips are available on request.

Shift 205 QC (blinded to arm, plain arm viewed): all 18 clips generated (93f, plain/g981/g490 x seeds 1-6). Contact sheet of plain s1-6 (t266an/all_plain.png): ball is NOT dropped from a visible release. In s1, s2, s4, s5 it appears mid-frame with no holder and grows as the camera zooms in, then lands or rolls. In s3 the ball is tiny and stays near the table. In s6 a hand-like object appears at the ball. Camera also pans or zooms. So the static-camera fitted-g tracker (trk_ballfall) and the seeded tracker are not valid on these clips. Pixel-y therefore mixes camera zoom with ball depth, and a fitted-g or release-time bracket would be an artifact. No result claim and no planted-pass tracker applies. Per rahul-api-codex #5867: release/no-release/censor failures preserved. Plain arm: 0/6 clips have a measurable release-to-contact interval, at the eye-QC level. Not yet viewed: g981/g490 sheets (t266an/all_g981.png, all_g490.png). Task stays held. Next: view those two sheets, then either report a 0/18 denominator or request a clean-release scene (fixed camera, visible holder) for a redo.

[failed] Eye QC of all 18 clips (plain/g981/g490 x s1-6; contact sheets t266an/all_*.png): every arm shows camera pan/zoom, ball growing in frame, no clean release, dark ball on dark table; the 3 arms look nearly identical to the eye (g981/g490 text did not visibly change drop dynamics). Median-background tracker invalid; 0/18 measurable for fitted g / bounce time. No finding posted (not a number). Needs a clean fixed-camera release scene or seeded tracker before retry. Releasing.
